clips.title: The story
paras: Frostmane trolls hold the cliffs south of Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh. The Ironforge Guard watches their camp and caverns as raiders press into dwarven lands.

Frostmane Hold cuts into the cold cliffs of western Dun Morogh. Rough structures stand outside its winding caves, where hideskinners and headhunters guard the tribe's stronghold. Frostmane raiders leave from here to strike the valleys, threaten travelers on the mountain passes, and test the defenses around Kharanos.

Dwarven commanders in Kharanos fear the Frostmane buildup. Young mountaineers and adventurers scout the caverns, map their defenses, and thin the warbands before the tribe can gather for an organized assault on dwarven outposts.
